name: explain
works_with: Claude Code (the README is written for Claude Code skills folders)
short: Makes your coding agent explain code and concepts in plain, short English, with diagrams or a one-page sheet when useful.
what: A skill that triggers whenever you ask your coding agent to explain something: code, a flow, a bug, a concept or an architecture. It picks the lightest format that works (text, an ASCII or sketch-style diagram, a one-page HTML reference sheet, or a video only if asked) and writes in simplified technical English based on ASD-STE100 rules. It also has an "explain like I'm 13" mode that uses one everyday analogy throughout.
who: Anyone who uses Claude Code to understand an unfamiliar codebase or topic and wants shorter, clearer answers. Skip it if you prefer long, detailed prose, or if you use a different agent and don't want to adapt the setup.
needs: curl, for the one-line install. Or a clone of the repo

For HTML pages and rich diagrams, the skill calls on an Artifact tool and the artifact-design and artifact-diagramming skills. For videos it names a faceless-explainer skill. None of these ship with this repo

steps.title: Install for one project
steps.text: Run this from your project folder. For all your projects, use ~/.claude/skills/explain in both places instead of .claude/skills/explain.

steps.title: Restart Claude Code
steps.text: The skill loads when your request matches its description, so just ask for an explanation.

watch: The install downloads a single SKILL.md file. It does not run any script. Read the file after downloading if you want to check it.
The README gives no license, so reuse terms are not stated.
The richer formats depend on tools and skills from outside this repo. Without them, expect text and ASCII diagrams.
